section_summary.extract_value: This Introduction outlines a single empirical analysis conducted in a college female sample that tests a partial sociocultural model linking frequency of overhearing family fat talk to mindful eating, body appreciation, and functional body appreciation. It frames hypotheses that family fat talk will be inversely associated with mindful eating and positive body image and that body appreciation variables may mediate effects (controlling for BMI).
